newsitem.title: GREECE: Hellenic Invest goes ex-div/ex-rights Apr 16.
newsitem.headline: Hellenic Invest goes ex-div/ex-rights Apr 16.

text.p: Closed-end fund Hellenic Investments got shareholder approval for a 6.41 billion drachma rights issue during its annual shareholders meeting on Tuesday.
The fund will trade ex-rights Wednesday April 16. It will issue 3,375,000 new common bearer shares at 1,900 drachmas -- three new shares per 10 outstanding.

"The issue price is at a 17.1 percent discount from the fund's net asset value per share at the end of the first quarter -- 2,292 drachmas after the dividend payout," the fund's president George Papathanassiou told shareholders.

On the same date the shares will trade ex-dividend, he said. Subscriptions to the rights issue will last one month with the new shares entitled to the 1997 dividend. Underwriter for the issue will be ETBA Bank. ($ = 271.9 Greek Drachmas)
